subject: Pilot credit cap and cohort split — BetaLaunch request
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina@betalaunch.org>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: BetaLaunch Procurement <procure@betalaunch.org>
Date: Sun, 4 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credit cap and cohort split — BetaLaunch request

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the founders were excited about the latency and cost profile. We are lining up our summer cohort (12 startups) and wanted to confirm the details for the pilot credits and how credits can be allocated across companies. A couple of asks: 

- Can credits be issued per-startup and also pooled at the cohort level for reallocation?
- Is there a hard cap / expiry on promo credits?
- Any restrictions on transferring credits between orgs?
- How do overages work (can startups buy additional blocks at a discounted rate)?

Attached a brief SOW-lite for context. Also looping in procurement for T&Cs.

Thanks,
Lina Gomez
Program Director, BetaLaunch
[Attachment: SOW-lite.pdf]

---
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@betalaunch.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credit cap and cohort split — BetaLaunch request

Hi Lina — great to hear the founders liked the demo. Quick answers up front, then a proposed structure: 

- Yes, we can do both per-startup allocations and a cohort-level pool.
- Promo credits typically expire 6 months from issuance by default; we can extend to 9 months for accelerator cohorts on a case-by-case basis.
- Transferrable credits are allowed if BetaLaunch designates a single cohort admin who manages allocations — we require audit logs and an allocation manifest for compliance.
- Overages can be purchased at a promo discount; standard offer is 20% off list for the first 90 days after promo depletion.

Proposed pilot package (starter suggestion):
- 3,000,000 token credits per startup (12 startups) + cohort pool of 8,000,000 tokens to be reallocated as needed.
- Credits expire 9 months after issuance.
- Cohort admin (BetaLaunch) gets a simple allocation dashboard and CSV export for audit.

I'm looping Ben (partnerships) for flexibility on the cohort pool and Marissa for onboarding/CS details. I've attached our standard MA template for pilots — if procurement needs edits, point them to the sections they'd like to change.

Next steps: if that structure looks ok, Ben will confirm pricing for the cohort-level pool and we can send a DocuSign bundle.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
[Attachment: beta_launch_ma_template.pdf]

---
From: Lina Gomez <lina@betalaunch.org>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: BetaLaunch Procurement <procure@betalaunch.org>
Date: Mon, 5 May 2025 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credit cap and cohort split — BetaLaunch request

Thanks Stephanie — that layout is helpful. A few follow-ups from our side: 

1) The cohort needs a larger shared pool — founders will vary a lot. Can we move the cohort pool to 10M?
2) Some startups expect higher usage; would you entertain 4M per startup in exchange for us committing to a case study and intro to two portfolio VCs?
3) Data residency note: two of our startups require EU-residency for logs. Is there a residency guarantee tied to the pilot credits or is that a separate charge?

Procurement also asked whether credits can be partially refunded if a startup drops before using them.

Lina

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@betalaunch.org>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 May 2025 10:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credit cap and cohort split — BetaLaunch request

Hi Lina — appreciate the specifics, happy to propose a compromise that balances founder flexibility with predictable unit economics for us and you. Proposed revised terms: 

- Per-startup allocation: 3,500,000 token credits each (up from 3M)
- Cohort pool: 10,000,000 tokens reserved for cross-allocation by BetaLaunch admin
- Credit expiry: 9 months from issuance
- Overages: cohort startups get a renewal/overage purchase window at 25% off list for the first 120 days after promo depletion (we can invoice monthly)
- Refunds: unused credits are not refundable, but BetaLaunch can reassign unused balances to other cohort participants before the 9-month expiry. This keeps accounting clean.

On data residency — residency guarantees are part of our Private deployment offering and typically require a separate setup fee and minimum commitment. For pilot credits on Hosted, we can guarantee that logs are isolated per-tenant and provide audit export, but not an EU-residency SLA. If some startups require EU data locality, we can scope a short-term Dedicated tranche for them; I'll drop a quick usage projection for the cohort to show cost delta.

Attached: pilot usage projection (example). If the case study/VC intros are confirmed, we can consider bumping the per-startup allocation to 4M as a marketing allowance — we'll flag that as a partnership credit and require completion of a short success plan.

Thanks — Ben
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pilot_usage_projection.xlsx]

Subject: Re: Pilot credit cap and cohort split — BetaLaunch request

Lina — thanks for the fast responses and the clear asks. To summarize and confirm next steps so procurement has a single doc to review: 

Summary of agreed commercial proposal (proposal to send to DocuSign):
- 3.5M token credits per startup (12 startups) — baseline
- Cohort pool of 10M tokens controlled by BetaLaunch admin for reallocation
- Credits expire 9 months after issuance
- Overages available at 25% off list for first 120 days after depletion
- Credits are non-refundable but transferable within cohort prior to expiry (must be tracked via allocation manifest)
- If any startups require EU-residency for logs we will scope a Dedicated option separately (separate SOW/fee)

Operational items: 
- Marissa will own onboarding and will provide an onboarding checklist and kick-off date once the agreement is signed.
- Ben will include the partnership credit note (case study/VC intro) in the DocuSign bundle if BetaLaunch confirms the commitments.

Action items: 
- Lina / Procurement: confirm whether the cohort will commit to the case study & intros (yes/no) — that will determine whether the per-startup allocation is bumped to 4M.
- Procurement: review attached MA and flag any redlines by 2025-05-09 so we can hit a mid-May start.
- BetaLaunch admin email for allocation dashboard: please provide the admin email for the allocation manifest (required before issuance).

DocuSign packet: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123

If that reads right, I'll ask Legal to prepare the pilot MA and Ben will prepare the billing schedule. Happy to hop on a quick call if procurement wants to walk through table rows.

Thanks all,
